text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I... lost?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The strongest racer in the world should
be
strongest in her generation! But...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Everyone is so much stronger than I
thought.
Spe... Everyone...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Victory at the Derby escapes El Condor
Pasa's
grasp.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
While I think there are a lot of factors
that played
into our defeat... it's still a
hard result to face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Good match, El! Thank you for running
with me
today!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, I was able to do my best!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: How did you do it, Spe?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
How did you get so strong all of a
sudden?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Huh? I've just been training a lot. I didn't
do
anything special...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
But you know... Since you were my
opponent, I
felt like I had to do my very
best on behalf of
everyone who trained
with me.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: That's why I could run so hard today.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: You had to work hard for everyone...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I see...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса is sitting in the park,
reflecting on
her unexpected defeat.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
From a distance, I watch Грасс Вандер
cheer her
up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Pick your head up, El. You did a really
good job
today. You should be proud of
yourself.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I guess...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: You're really having a tough time, huh?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
At a loss, Грасс Вандер walks towards
me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yeah. She's usually so confident.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I think she's surprised by how big the
gap was
between her real ability and
how she imagined
herself.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
She's always been so untouchable, so
this must
have been a harsh wake-up
call...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Can you take it from here, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Of course I'm worried. But...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
As competitors, there are certain
feelings we
can't share with each other.
Or we ought not to,
rather.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: So please... do what you can.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Грасс Вандер leaves with a slight bow.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Have I been... too arrogant?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I thought it would be an easy race. I'm
aiming to
be the world's strongest racer,
after all...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But I was totally wrong. Not only was it
not easy, I
couldn't even catch up...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I keep saying I'm aiming for the world...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But am I really just taking the easy way
out by not
competing with my friends?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: If that's the case, I... I...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Nothing can be discerned from a single
match. I'm
not quite sure what to think
of this one.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You know what? I was probably just
tired. I'm
usually hella strong when I run!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
So long as I'm wearing this mask, there
isn't
anything to fear... or at least, there
shouldn't be!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: So that means our next race is...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: The Japan C-Cu... Cu...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
She can't say it. It's clear that she's
caught
between pride and reality.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's impossible to keep pushing forward
like this.
We might want to add another
step along the
way.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The Mainichi Okan? Well, it is before the fall G1...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The perfect fall G1 prelude—a
1,800-meter race
that seniors run in as
well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
From there, she can advance to the
Japan Cup,
the Triple Crown tour Kikuka
Sho, or the Mile
Championship.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: It feels kinda like... a cop-out. But...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I understand. There's a lot I wanna think
about
before fall...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Her mask is slipping... She's wavering for
the first
time on her road to becoming
the world's
strongest racer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
